text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Tomo and Mitsuki were eliminating the monsters that appeared one after the other with furious force.
text_block_list.orig_text:
トモとミツキは、
次から次へと現れる魔物を怒涛の勢いで片付けていた。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Tomo-chan! It's coming your way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
トモちゃん、
そっちに行ったわ！

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
任せてください！　
はぁ～～！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Impressive work. Hehe. Straightforward cooperation isn't bad once in a while.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お見事。
ふふ。
まっすぐな連携ってのも、
たまには悪くないわね。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Straightforward, you say?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まっすぐ、
ですか？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: All the members of my guild are weirdos, after all. As a result, even if we end up working together, it'll never be like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちのギルドのメンバーはみんな曲者だからね。
結果的に連携することはあっても、
こんなふうにはいかないから。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Cooperation is the first priority in a fight to those of us in the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE, so I can't imagine any other way of fighting than this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】は連携が第一だから、
こういう戦い方以外、
想像がつかないですね。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Ah, but there's one exception among us. And if I think of a guild of people just like her... Twilight Caravan just comes off as terrifying.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
一人例外がいますけど。
あんなのばっかりの集団って考えたら……
【トワイライトキャラバン】って恐ろしいギルドですね。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Personally, I think it's much better than having a bunch of people who are neither "poison" nor "medicine" gather together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
でも、
毒にも薬にもならない人間が寄り集まるよりは
ずっといいと思うけど。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Neither poison nor medicine...
text_block_list.orig_text: 毒にも薬にもならない……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: I'm not saying that the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE are like that, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】がそうだって
言ってるんじゃないわよ？

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: That's not it. I just thought that that's the kind of person I am now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
違うんです。
今の私が
そういう人間だなって思っただけで。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by that?
text_block_list.orig_text: どういうことかしら？

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: You've come just at the right time...
text_block_list.orig_text: ちょうどいいところに来てくれた。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Eh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: It's been bothering me all this time! I couldn't defeat that horde of monsters by myself back then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ずっと気に掛かってたんです！
さっき魔物の大群を一人で倒し切れなかったこと！

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: So, this time...! I'll handle this and get rid of them all by myself! Please don't lay a finger to help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
今度こそ私一人で倒します！
手出し無用でお願いします！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Being young comes with its own share of troubles. It can't be helped.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
若いってのも困りものだわ。
仕方ないわね。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Yet again, in secret...
text_block_list.orig_text: またこっそりと……

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: There...!
text_block_list.orig_text: そこ……！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Oh, my.
text_block_list.orig_text: あら。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: I knew it, so you were using something to defeat those monsters. And let me guess, it'd be a problem if I saw you, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり魔物を倒すのに
何か使っていたんですね。
私に見られたら困るものですか？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't really call it a problem, but... More importantly, shouldn't we deal with those monsters first?
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に困るというほどのものではないけれど……
それより
まずはあっちを対処した方がいいんじゃないかしら？

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: You're right on that. But I'll have you explain what's in your hand later.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね。
でもその手の中のものも
あとで説明してもらいますよ。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: I think it'd be faster to show you rather than talking it over... like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
口で言うより見せた方が早いと思うけど……
こんなふうに。

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: A-All those monsters in just one blow...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
魔物が一撃で……！？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: This is a poison that's still in an experimental stage. If possible, I'd have liked for nobody to see it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これはまだ実験中の毒薬なの。
できれば誰にも見られたくなかったんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: But to think you'd notice it. Maybe I underestimated you a little too much. What will you do, Tomo-chan? Will you arrest me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか
気付かれていたとはね。
ちょっと甘く見すぎてたかしら。
どうするトモちゃん、
私を捕まえる？

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: I won't arrest you. After all, Mitsuki-san... all you did was defeating those monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
捕まえませんよ。
だってミツキさんは
ただ魔物を倒しただけですから。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? I thought for sure you were pretending to be stupid and rushing into those monsters in order to get evidence to arrest me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいの？　
てっきり私を捕まえる証拠を引き出すために
おバカなふりして魔物に突っ込んだんだと思ってたんだけど。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: The aim wasn't to arrest you. I mean, if I didn't trust you to help me, Mitsuki-san, I wouldn't have thrown myself into danger like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
捕まえるためじゃありませんよ。
だって、
ミツキさんが助けてくれるって信じてなきゃ
あんなおバカな真似はできませんから。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: The reason why... is that I felt disgusted by my behaviour of not questioning you when I felt suspicious about your character, Mitsuki-san.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただ私は、
ミツキさんが不審な行動をとっていたことに
気付いてたのに、
それを問い詰めない自分が
気持ち悪かったんです。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: I don't think it's appropriate for a Royal Knight of NIGHTMARE to just be swept away from the flow of things like I have.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとなく流されてしまうのは
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】に
相応しくないなって。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Which is why I put on an "idiot" act to find out instead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからそれを確かめるために
おバカな一芝居を打ったってわけです。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, underlining your own stupidity like that, I wonder if you're holding a grudge because I defined your gesture as such?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
おバカって言ったことを根に持ってるのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Hehe, maybe a little. But I'm glad I was able to confirm for myself that you're a good person, Mitsuki-san.
text_block_list.orig_text:
少しだけ。
でも
ミツキさんがいい人だってことを
確認できてよかったです。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: The usage of that poison is also meant to just defeat monsters more efficiently, correct?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その毒も
魔物をより効率的に倒すためのものですよね。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Hm? If you're asking about its usage... I guess I'm trying to make it so it becomes undetectable in the long run?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
この毒は
いずれ、
検出できない毒に
改良していく予定だけど？

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: ... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Eh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Confiscated! I'll confiscate that poison right now! As much of it as I can!
text_block_list.orig_text:
没収！　
その毒は没収します！
あるだけ全部没収です！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, if you're really planning to confiscate it, then atleast let me use it on the monsters in this tower. That way I'll gather more data, which in and of itself will be more useful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
没収されるくらいだったら
この塔の魔物に使いましょう。
データも集まるし、
その方が有意義だわ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} sighed in exasperation as he watched Mitsuki happily run away from Tomo who was chasing after her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
追いかけるトモから楽しそうに逃げるミツキを見ながら、
{0}はやれやれとため息をつくのであった。
